item.title: Ruby Core Takes Ownership of Rubygems and Bundler
item.description:
📝 Despite this crucial role, RubyGems and Bundler have historically been developed outside the Ruby organization on GitHub, unlike other major components of the Ruby ecosystem. We will continue their development in close collaboration with Ruby Central and the broader community. This website is proudly maintained by members of the Ruby community.

item.title: Ring to partner with Flock, a network of cameras used by ICE, feds, and police
item.description:
📝 In Brief Posted: 11:35 AM PDT · October 16, 2025 Image Credits:Amazon Ring Amanda Silberling Amazon’s Ring to partner with Flock, a network of AI cameras used by ICE, feds, and police Amazon’s surveillance camera maker Ring announced a partnership on Thursday with Flock, a maker of AI-powered surveillance cameras that share footage with law enforcement. By partnering with Ring, Flock could potentially access footage from millions more cameras. Investors: Meet startups that align with your investment goals.
🔗 Read more: https://techcrunch.com/2025/10/16/amazons-ring-to-partner-with-flock-a-network-of-ai-cameras-used-by-ice-feds-and-police/

item.title: Codebase is 250% AI generated
item.description:
📝 From this IA, everything else flows. A similar thing happens in your codebase. Sometimes, the presence of one useless feature induces the AI to build another useless feature, which itself becomes useless fluff that amplifies throughout your codebase.
🔗 Read more: https://www.moderndescartes.com/essays/ai_codebase/
